about: packages/soil/src/props.json: the soil story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: A cut-away block of soil with a wheat plant (ears, leaves, fibrous roots and root hairs): fertiliser falls and dissolves into amber ammonium, flows of nitrogen climb the roots or pass through the relay (rose nitrite, blue nitrate washing out, lilac N2O rising); a magnified pore with the relay's microbes (archaea, ammonia-oxidising bacteria, nitrite oxidisers, comammox); the BNI halo round the roots, the wild grass and the piece of chromosome moving into the wheat; one marked atom followed from grain to leaf.
sets.frame: The block centred on the origin, its surface at y = 0: 1.2 wide (x), 0.8 deep (z), down to y = -0.7; the wheat at the origin, its awns up to about y = 0.83, its roots down to about -0.62; the wild grass beside it at x = -0.86.
sets.size: block 1.2 x 0.8 x 0.7; the plant to 0.83 above it

params.name: soil_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: soil_grow
params.meaning: the plant and its roots grow from nothing (roots first, then the stem, the leaves bottom to top, the ears from 0.62; the hairs follow the roots)

params.name: soil_cut
params.meaning: 0 a closed block; 1 the faces nearer the viewer turn to glass (whichever side that is) and seven in ten grains in front of the plant shrink away

params.name: soil_fert
params.meaning: fertiliser grains fall, land, sink a little and dissolve (0.36 to 0.98) into amber ammonium glowing round them

params.name: soil_flow
params.meaning: how many flow particles run: a share (soil_plant) climbs a root as green into the stem; about 12 % turns rose and rises as lilac N2O wisps; the rest turns rose, then blue (nitrate) and sinks out of the bottom

params.name: soil_plant
params.meaning: the plant's share of the flows (0.45: a drawing of the slides' "less than half")

params.name: soil_inhibit
params.meaning: slows the relay's first step: particles stay amber longer, more reach the roots, fewer leave as N2O or nitrate (explore: the BNI wheat 0.6, DCD 0.8)

params.name: soil_halo
params.meaning: the BNI halo: a soft teal glow along the roots, seeping outwards

params.name: soil_dcd
params.meaning: yellow DCD granules in the top soil (explore only)

params.name: soil_pore
params.meaning: a magnified pore grows out of the pore spot (a glass bubble, radius 0.3) while the block dims behind it

params.name: soil_relay
params.meaning: the relay's microbes come in one guild per step (1 archaea, 2 ammonia-oxidising bacteria, 3 nitrite oxidisers, 4 comammox), handing on glowing particles, amber to rose to blue

params.name: soil_grass
params.meaning: the wild grass (Leymus racemosus, drawn) grows beside the block

params.name: soil_chrom
params.meaning: the grass's and the wheat's chromosomes grow in (to 0.12); the marked segment lifts out (to 0.5) and glides into the wheat's (to 0.92), which glows

params.name: soil_tracer
params.meaning: one white atom with a trail: from a fertiliser grain down through the soil, into a microbe (it waits and flickers), out to a root and up into a leaf

params.name: soil_pick
params.meaning: a guild lit in the pore (0 archaea, 1 bacteria, 2 nitrite oxidisers, 3 comammox), the others dimmed; -1 none

data.text: A drawing: the only number it stands for is the slides' "less than half of the fertiliser ends up in the plant" (soil_plant 0.45); the flows' shares, the pore, the halo and the chromosome are illustrative and labelled so ("Illustration").

sets.notes: soil_pick is a step. All glows are one pool of additive points drawn without depth test, so the flows read through the cut-away block. Build 60 to 150 ms; 6 draw calls with the block alone, 9 with the pore open; 81k to 92k triangles. Exports api (pick, guildAt, tracer, roots).

reuses: flock/flock (its swaying reeds adapted as the wheat)
ovary/charts (its stacking movement adapted for the cores)
sets.shows: The trial's 24 plots in four blocks (two wheat lines, three regimes) under netting, the wheat growing over five dates with its leaves by each plot's measured chlorophyll, ammonium and nitrate under each plot from the data, jars on a bench breathing N2O as read off the slides, 119 soil cores lifting and stacking into the design, and a module of the network lighting the plots where it is strong.
sets.frame: The plots on the x-z plane at y = 0 (about 1.8 by 1.2), a soil slab under them to y = -0.25, the wheat up to about 0.3, the netting at 0.42, the jars on a bench at x = 1.3 and the stack of cores behind at z = -0.95 (up to 0.75); the net set draws over it, centred at (0, 1.3, 0).
sets.size: field ~1.8 x 1.2 (2.2 wide with the bench)

params.name: field_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: field_grow
params.meaning: the wheat grows from bare soil (each stem staggered)

params.name: field_date
params.meaning: the sampling date: the wheat's height and stage (the Zadoks stages), the leaves' colour and the measures shown

params.name: field_net
params.meaning: the netting, drawn across from left to right; its posts rise first

params.name: field_chl
params.meaning: 0 a uniform green; 1 each plot's leaves by its chlorophyll at the date (days 1 to 24 the data's, day 70 read off the slides, day 53 on the line between)

params.name: field_nh4
params.meaning: each plot's top soil glows amber with its ammonium at the date

params.name: field_no3
params.meaning: blue light seeps down under each plot into the slab, as deep and bright as its nitrate at the date, with drops falling; the slab's near sides turn to glass

params.name: field_jars
params.meaning: the bench and the jars (one per regime and line: six, or thirty)

params.name: field_jday
params.meaning: the date whose soil is in the jars; -1 all five dates in rows

params.name: field_inc
params.meaning: the incubation's time: each jar's lilac N2O plume as high and dense as its curve read off the slides, with its ppm as a tag

params.name: field_cores
params.meaning: at each date a core lifts out of every plot sampled: 119 (the missing one never lifts)

params.name: field_stack
params.meaning: the cores fly in arcs into the stack of the design (3 regimes along x, the two lines front and back, 5 dates up, 4 cores each)

params.name: field_module
params.meaning: a module of the network (the engine keys it with net_focus)

params.name: field_mlit
params.meaning: each plot glows in the module's colour as far as the module's score in its sample at the date (negative: darker); light rises towards the cloud

params.name: field_pick
params.meaning: a group of plots lit, the others dimmed; -1 none

params.name: field_tags
params.meaning: tags on the picked group's four plots: the measure shown at the date, the group's mean against the other line's, with the p of that date

params.name: field_show
params.meaning: the measure: 0 chlorophyll, 1 ammonium, 2 nitrate, 3 N2O (the data's potential, unit not given), 4 pH

params.name: field_life
params.meaning: not built (the life-size field was optional): no effect

params.name: field_line
params.meaning: only one wheat line's plots lit (-1 both)

params.name: field_fert
params.meaning: only one regime's plots lit (-1 all)

data.text: Each plot's chlorophyll (days 1, 15, 24), ammonium and nitrate (all five dates), the tags' means and p values, the 119 cores and the modules' scores are the trial's data; day 70's chlorophyll and the jars' N2O curves are read off the slides (approximate); the plots' layout (the real map is not known), the wheat's look and the netting are illustrative.

sets.notes: field_jday, field_module, field_pick, field_show, field_line and field_fert are steps; field_life is not built. Build 50 to 150 ms; 7 to 9 draw calls; 47k triangles (62k with all thirty jars and the cores). Exports api (plotXZ, order, pick, plotAt, plot, jar, ppm, chlAt, value, mod).

sets.shows: The soil's crowd of microbes as a deep cloud (20,000 kinds by phylum: the common ones in its core, the rare ones in a faint shell), the nitrifiers flaring in their guilds' colours, the co-occurrence network of 1,564 kinds and 22,348 links pulling out of the core, a shuffle dissolving every link, its 17 modules in colour, and the halves' own networks side by side (by wheat line, fertiliser or at random).
sets.frame: In the field set's frame: the cloud centred at (0, 1.3, 0), radius about 0.7; the network scaled to radius about 0.6; split copies at x -0.6 and 0.6 (three: -0.8, 0, 0.8).

params.name: net_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: net_cloud
params.meaning: the cloud of 20,000 kinds appears from the centre outwards with a bright front (default 1)

params.name: net_nitro
params.meaning: the nitrifiers' kinds flare in their guilds' colours, larger, with their tags; the rest steps back

params.name: net_pull
params.meaning: the network's 1,564 kinds fly out of the core to their stored layout (each at its own moment); the rest of the cloud recedes to a faint shell

params.name: net_links
params.meaning: the 22,348 links fade in: rising together pale cyan, one up as the other goes down faint warm red

params.name: net_shuffle
params.meaning: the links shiver and fade to nothing while the kinds scatter a little: "Shuffled · not one link is left"

params.name: net_mods
params.meaning: kinds and links take their module's colour; the big modules' tags (size and what they follow)

params.name: net_rho
params.meaning: only the strongest links (a prefix of the stored order); kinds left without a link dim

params.name: net_focus
params.meaning: a module lit, the rest dimmed (the engine keys the field's field_module and field_mlit with it); -1 none

params.name: net_split
params.meaning: the network's copies move apart and fade in, each showing only the links its half's own network also has, with its tag

params.name: net_splitBy
params.meaning: 0 wheat line (two copies), 1 fertiliser (three), 2 at random (two halves)

params.name: net_kind
params.meaning: one kind picked: its bubble, its links lit, its neighbours cyan, its tag; -1 none

Shuffled · not one link is left

data.text: The trial's 16S kinds (20,000 for the cloud, the 3,384 common ones), the co-occurrence network built for this story (CLR, Spearman |rho| at least 0.6, q under 0.05, Louvain: correlation, not interaction), its modules, the shuffled null and the halves' own networks, all stored; the cloud's places and the network's layout are a drawing.

sets.notes: net_focus, net_splitBy and net_kind are steps; net_rho is a plain number (0.6 to 0.8). Adapted from the endotype story's net set (its cloud, the pull-out, the colours, focus and picking), without its walkers, heat and k. Build 55 to 135 ms; 6 draw calls at rest, 10 split in three; 20,260 points and 22,348 lines per copy. Exports api (n, nodes, centre, pick, pos, info, kindText, module, nodeOf, cloudOfNode, members, follows, nodesAt, guildTop).
